ucs.title: [LLM] APT37 / ScarCruft RokRAT cloud-service C2 (pCloud / Dropbox / Yandex)
ucs.description: Hunts non-browser, non-cloud-client processes beaconing to pCloud, Dropbox, and Yandex Disk APIs — the signature RokRAT / DOGCALL C2 + exfil pattern that ScarCruft (Reaper / InkySquid / Ricochet Chollima / Group123 / TEMP.Reaper) has used continuously since 2017. Public cloud abuse for C2 (T1102.002) is the most distinctive APT37 tradecraft and is what separates them from most other DPRK clusters.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Web.url) as url values(Web.http_user_agent) as ua values(Web.app) as app from datamodel=Web where Web.dest IN ("api.pcloud.com","content.dropboxapi.com","api.dropboxapi.com","cloud-api.yandex.net","webdav.yandex.com","oauth.yandex.com") by Web.src Web.user Web.app host | `drop_dm_object_name(Web)` | where NOT match(app, "(?i)(chrome|msedge|firefox|brave|iexplore|opera|onedrive|dropbox|yandexdisk|pcloud)\.exe$") | where NOT match(ua, "(?i)^(Mozilla|OneDriveSDK|OneDrive|Dropbox|Yandex|pCloud)") | `security_content_ctime(firstTime)` | `security_content_ctime(lastTime)`
ucs.kql:
let CloudC2Hosts = dynamic(["api.pcloud.com","content.dropboxapi.com","api.dropboxapi.com","cloud-api.yandex.net","webdav.yandex.com","oauth.yandex.com"]);
let Browsers = dynamic(["chrome.exe","msedge.exe","firefox.exe","brave.exe","iexplore.exe","opera.exe"]);
let CloudClients = dynamic(["onedrive.exe","dropbox.exe","yandexdisk.exe","yandex.disk.exe","pcloud.exe","filecoauth.exe"]);
DeviceNetworkEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(7d)
| where isnotempty(RemoteUrl)
| where RemoteUrl has_any (CloudC2Hosts)
| where InitiatingProcessFileName !in~ (Browsers)
| where InitiatingProcessFileName !in~ (CloudClients)
| where InitiatingProcessAccountName !endswith "$"
| where InitiatingProcessAccountName !in~ ("system","local service","network service")
| summarize FirstSeen = min(Timestamp), LastSeen = max(Timestamp), Hits = count(),
            Cmd = any(InitiatingProcessCommandLine), Sha = any(InitiatingProcessSHA256),
            Urls = make_set(RemoteUrl, 20)
            by DeviceName, AccountName = InitiatingProcessAccountName,
               Image = InitiatingProcessFolderPath, FileName = InitiatingProcessFileName
| order by FirstSeen desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let CloudC2Hosts = dynamic(["api.pcloud.com","content.dropboxapi.com","api.dropboxapi.com","cloud-api.yandex.net","webdav.yandex.com","oauth.yandex.com"]);
ImWebSession
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where HttpHostName has_any (CloudC2Hosts) or Url has_any (CloudC2Hosts)
| where isnotempty(HttpRequestHeaderUserAgent)
| where HttpRequestHeaderUserAgent !has_any ("Mozilla","Chrome","Edg/","Firefox","Safari","OneDrive","Dropbox","Yandex","pCloud")
| summarize FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated), LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated),
            Hits = count(), UAs = make_set(HttpRequestHeaderUserAgent, 10),
            Urls = make_set(Url, 20)
            by SrcHostname, SrcUsername, SrcIpAddr, DstHostname = HttpHostName
| order by FirstSeen desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: APT37 RokRAT Cloud Service C2 Channel
id: 5a3c8c11-9d77-4f2e-9a3d-6e3a2f1c4a01
status: experimental
description: Non-browser, non-cloud-client process beacons to pCloud / Dropbox / Yandex Disk APIs — ScarCruft RokRAT C2 pattern
references:
  - https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0067/
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026-06-16
logsource:
  category: network_connection
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_host:
    DestinationHostname:
      - api.pcloud.com
      - content.dropboxapi.com
      - api.dropboxapi.com
      - cloud-api.yandex.net
      - webdav.yandex.com
      - oauth.yandex.com
  filter_browser:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\chrome.exe'
      - '\msedge.exe'
      - '\firefox.exe'
      - '\brave.exe'
      - '\iexplore.exe'
      - '\opera.exe'
  filter_client:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\OneDrive.exe'
      - '\Dropbox.exe'
      - '\YandexDisk.exe'
      - '\pCloud.exe'
      - '\FileCoAuth.exe'
  condition: selection_host and not 1 of filter_*
falsepositives:
  - Custom internal apps that legitimately sync to consumer cloud (rare in enterprise)
level: high
tags:
  - attack.command_and_control
  - attack.exfiltration
  - attack.t1102.002
  - attack.t1071.001
  - attack.t1567.002
  - apt.scarcruft
  - apt.apt37
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:3 @DestinationHostname:(api.pcloud.com OR content.dropboxapi.com OR api.dropboxapi.com OR cloud-api.yandex.net OR webdav.yandex.com OR oauth.yandex.com) -@Image:(*\chrome.exe OR *\Chrome.exe OR *\msedge.exe OR *\msEdge.exe OR *\firefox.exe OR *\Firefox.exe OR *\iexplore.exe OR *\brave.exe OR *\OneDrive.exe OR *\onedrive.exe OR *\Dropbox.exe OR *\dropbox.exe OR *\YandexDisk.exe OR *\yandexdisk.exe OR *\pCloud.exe OR *\pcloud.exe OR *\FileCoAuth.exe)
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=DnsRequest DomainName=/^(api\.pcloud\.com|content\.dropboxapi\.com|api\.dropboxapi\.com|cloud-api\.yandex\.net|webdav\.yandex\.com|oauth\.yandex\.com)$/i
| NOT (ContextImageFileName=/\\(chrome|msedge|firefox|brave|iexplore|opera|onedrive|dropbox|yandexdisk|pcloud|filecoauth)\.exe$/i)
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, ContextImageFileName, DomainName], function=count(as=Hits))
| Hits >= 1
ucs.rationale: RokRAT / DOGCALL / KARAE — APT37's flagship custom RAT family — abuses pCloud (api.pcloud.com), Dropbox (content.dropboxapi.com), and Yandex Disk (cloud-api.yandex.net) as both command channel and exfil bucket. ucs.title: [LLM] APT37 / ScarCruft HWP / LNK / CHM lure spawning fileless loader
ucs.description: Hunts the ScarCruft / Group123 initial-access chain where a weaponised Hangul (HWP) document, LNK shortcut shipped inside a RAR/ZIP, or CHM help file launches PowerShell / mshta / wscript with hidden-window + encoded / IEX patterns to stage RokRAT. The Hangul Office (hwp.exe) parent is essentially a DPRK fingerprint — APT37 is the dominant operator of HWP exploits against South Korean defectors, journalists, and reunification policy targets.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.process) as process values(Processes.parent_process) as parent_process values(Processes.process_hash) as process_hash from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.parent_process_name IN ("explorer.exe","hwp.exe","Hwp.exe","Hwp70.exe","Hwp80.exe","hh.exe","outlook.exe","winrar.exe","7zFM.exe") Processes.process_name IN ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","mshta.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe","rundll32.exe","regsvr32.exe","cmd.exe") (Processes.process="*-w hidden*" OR Processes.process="*-windowstyle hidden*" OR Processes.process="*-EncodedCommand*" OR Processes.process="*-enc *" OR Processes.process="*-ec *" OR Processes.process="*DownloadString*" OR Processes.process="*IEX*" OR Processes.process="*Invoke-Expression*" OR Processes.process="*.lnk*" OR Processes.process="*.chm*" OR Processes.process="*.hwp*" OR Processes.process="*FromBase64String*") by host Processes.user Processes.process_name Processes.parent_process_name | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | where NOT match(user, "(?i)\$$") | `security_content_ctime(firstTime)` | `security_content_ctime(lastTime)`
ucs.kql:
let LureParents = dynamic(["explorer.exe","hwp.exe","hwp70.exe","hwp80.exe","hh.exe","outlook.exe","winrar.exe","7zfm.exe","bandizip.exe"]);
let ScriptChildren = dynamic(["powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","mshta.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe","rundll32.exe","regsvr32.exe","cmd.exe"]);
let SuspTokens = dynamic(["-w hidden","-windowstyle hidden","-WindowStyle Hidden","-EncodedCommand","-enc ","-ec ","DownloadString","IEX","Invoke-Expression","FromBase64String",".lnk",".chm",".hwp","javascript:"]);
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(7d)
| where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ (LureParents)
| where FileName in~ (ScriptChildren)
| where ProcessCommandLine has_any (SuspTokens)
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| where AccountName !in~ ("system","local service","network service")
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName,
          ParentImage = InitiatingProcessFolderPath,
          ParentCmd   = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
          ChildImage  = FolderPath,
          ChildCmd    = ProcessCommandLine,
          SHA256, InitiatingProcessSHA256
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let LureParentsRx = @"(?i)\\(explorer|hwp|hwp70|hwp80|hh|outlook|winrar|7zfm|bandizip)\.exe$";
let ScriptChildrenRx = @"(?i)\\(powershell|pwsh|mshta|wscript|cscript|rundll32|regsvr32|cmd)\.exe$";
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where EventID == 4688
| where ParentProcessName matches regex LureParentsRx
| where NewProcessName matches regex ScriptChildrenRx
| where CommandLine has_any ("-w hidden","-windowstyle hidden","-EncodedCommand","-enc ","-ec ","DownloadString","IEX","Invoke-Expression","FromBase64String",".lnk",".chm",".hwp","javascript:")
| where SubjectUserName !endswith "$"
| where SubjectUserName !in~ ("system","local service","network service")
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, SubjectUserName, ParentProcessName, NewProcessName, CommandLine
| order by TimeGenerated desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: APT37 ScarCruft Lure (HWP / LNK / CHM) Spawning Fileless Loader
id: 8b1a7e22-1b88-4a4f-b1e2-7c2b3d5e9f02
status: experimental
description: APT37 spear-phish lures — Hangul (.hwp), LNK shipped in RAR/ZIP, or CHM — spawn powershell / mshta / wscript with hidden-window or encoded payload to stage RokRAT / DOGCALL
references:
  - https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0067/
  - https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0240/
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026-06-16
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_parent:
    ParentImage|endswith:
      - '\explorer.exe'
      - '\hwp.exe'
      - '\Hwp.exe'
      - '\Hwp70.exe'
      - '\Hwp80.exe'
      - '\hh.exe'
      - '\outlook.exe'
      - '\OUTLOOK.EXE'
      - '\winrar.exe'
      - '\7zFM.exe'
      - '\Bandizip.exe'
  selection_child:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\powershell.exe'
      - '\pwsh.exe'
      - '\mshta.exe'
      - '\wscript.exe'
      - '\cscript.exe'
      - '\rundll32.exe'
      - '\regsvr32.exe'
      - '\cmd.exe'
  selection_cmd:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - '-w hidden'
      - '-windowstyle hidden'
      - '-WindowStyle Hidden'
      - '-EncodedCommand'
      - '-enc '
      - '-ec '
      - 'DownloadString'
      - 'IEX'
      - 'Invoke-Expression'
      - 'FromBase64String'
      - '.lnk'
      - '.chm'
      - '.hwp'
      - 'javascript:'
  condition: all of selection_*
falsepositives:
  - Legitimate admin remote-execution via PSRemoting (filter on known admin SIDs)
  - Software installers shipping LNK launcher patterns (rare with hidden-window)
level: high
tags:
  - attack.initial_access
  - attack.execution
  - attack.t1566.001
  - attack.t1204.002
  - attack.t1059.001
  - attack.t1059.005
  - attack.t1218.005
  - apt.scarcruft
  - apt.apt37
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 @ParentImage:(*\explorer.exe OR *\Explorer.exe OR *\hwp.exe OR *\Hwp.exe OR *\HWP.exe OR *\Hwp70.exe OR *\Hwp80.exe OR *\hh.exe OR *\outlook.exe OR *\OUTLOOK.EXE OR *\winrar.exe OR *\WinRAR.exe OR *\7zFM.exe OR *\Bandizip.exe) @Image:(*\powershell.exe OR *\PowerShell.exe OR *\POWERSHELL.EXE OR *\pwsh.exe OR *\mshta.exe OR *\MSHTA.exe OR *\MSHTA.EXE OR *\wscript.exe OR *\WScript.exe OR *\cscript.exe OR *\CScript.exe OR *\rundll32.exe OR *\RunDLL32.exe OR *\regsvr32.exe OR *\RegSvr32.exe OR *\cmd.exe OR *\CMD.EXE) @CommandLine:(*hidden* OR *Hidden* OR *EncodedCommand* OR *DownloadString* OR *IEX* OR *Invoke-Expression* OR *FromBase64String* OR *.lnk* OR *.LNK* OR *.chm* OR *.CHM* OR *.hwp* OR *.HWP*)
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2 ParentBaseFileName=/(explorer|hwp|hwp70|hwp80|hh|outlook|winrar|7zfm|bandizip)\.exe$/i ImageFileName=/\\(powershell|pwsh|mshta|wscript|cscript|rundll32|regsvr32|cmd)\.exe$/i
| regex("(?i)(-w(indowstyle)?\\s+hidden|-e(nc|c|ncodedcommand)\\s|DownloadString|IEX|Invoke-Expression|FromBase64String|\\.lnk|\\.chm|\\.hwp|javascript:)", field=CommandLine)
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName, ParentBaseFileName, ImageFileName], function={ count(as=Hits) | _sample := selectFromMin(field=@timestamp, include=[CommandLine, SHA256HashData]) })
| Hits >= 1
